verdict.rationale: The evidence has no Zero control, setting, or policy that addresses AI model training: no opt-out and no statement that user data is excluded from training by Zero or by the AI providers behind its features. The closest items are a general pledge that Zero 'does not track, collect, or sell your data' and the option to self-host. These are adjacent privacy claims rather than the training-prevention capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
